title: Thalamic local field potentials during reading aloud of words and nonwords (Wang et al., 2022): 11 essential tremor patients, DBS surgery (derivative: preprocessed epochs)
description: Thalamic local field potentials recorded from the ventral lateral thalamus of 11 essential tremor patients during awake deep brain stimulation (DBS) lead implantation. Patients read aloud consonant-vowel-consonant words and nonwords. Recordings came from mapping-track macroelectrodes or the implanted DBS lead. This derivative release contains the authors' preprocessed, epoched signals (notch-filtered, resampled to 1 kHz, band-limited 2-400 Hz), repackaged in BIDS iEEG format with MNI contact coordinates.
methods_description: Recordings were made intraoperatively with a Neuro Omega system (Alpha Omega; 44 kHz) from mapping-electrode macro rings in 4 patients, and with a Ripple Grapevine processor (30 kHz) from Medtronic 3387 DBS leads in 7 patients. Contacts were localized with Lead-DBS and normalized to MNI ICBM152 NLIN 2009b. Preprocessing by the authors included notch filtering, resampling to 1 kHz, 2-400 Hz band-pass filtering, and epoching around each trial.
